title: pm-dispatch: the selection order never reads `priority:p1`/`p2`/`p3` — an older p3 outranks a newer p2 inside 「其余」; write priority into 取卡全序
body:
Filed by the skills seat from a measurement taken while answering the maintainer's question about the `domain:ui` backlog (2026-09-06T15:0xZ). The maintainer's expectation, verbatim: 「项目经理的技能不应该就是先派高优先级的任务吗」. The rule text does not say so for `priority:p1` / `p2` / `p3`.

## The measurement

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, the 候选与批次 block, the selection order as written on `main` (3e270d4e29):

> 取卡全序:`priority:p0` 插队 > `pm:blocking` > `target:` 板上项 > type `Bug` > 其余;同级按卡龄。

`references/core-rules.md` digests it the same way (「取卡全序:插队卡、有下游依赖者的卡、发版板上项、缺陷卡、其余,同级按卡龄」), and `references/dispatch-runbook.md`'s rationale line names p0, blocking, bug and age — **`priority:p1` / `p2` / `p3` appear in none of the three.** Only `p0` is read, as a queue-jump. Inside the 「其余」 level an older p3 outranks a newer p2, and a p3 typed `Bug` outranks a p2 finding of any age.

The triage seat grades every card with a priority label; that label today changes what a human sees and nothing about what the machine takes. The seats that do take p1/p2 first (the `domain:ui` seat's R1 this afternoon: one p1 + four p2 in flight) do so by judgment, which the next shift is free not to share.

Live instance, objectui `domain:ui` `pm:queue` at 14:15Z: 124 cards — `priority:p1` 3, `p2` 45, `p3` 56, ungraded 20. Under the written order those 124 are one level ordered by age, with the 56 p3 cards (79 of the 124 are `finding`s) interleaved among the 45 p2.

## The rule to land

Write priority into the order, as one line in each of the three texts:

> 取卡全序:`priority:p0` 插队 > `pm:blocking` > `target:` 板上项 > `priority:p1` > `p2` > `p3` > 无级;同级内 type `Bug` 先,再按卡龄。

- Priority outranks type: the triage seat's priority is its judgment of harm, and a p3 `Bug` is by that judgment less urgent than a p2 enhancement; type still breaks ties inside a level.
- Ungraded (`pm:queue` with no `priority:*`) sorts last and is named in the round report as a triage gap — it is not taken ahead of a graded card; it is not a reason to invent a grade at the execution seat (类型与优先级由分诊席唯一生产).
- The existing sentence 「全序每级取既有信号现读/现算,零逐卡维护;优先是排序不是豁免」 holds unchanged: priority labels are an existing signal, read at selection.

This is what the maintainer's pushback on a "p3 freeze" asked for: no label moves, no parking of p3 cards; the queue stays whole and the machine reads the grade it already carries.

## Acceptance

- `SKILL.md` (811/811, pin 342), `references/core-rules.md` (150/150) and `references/dispatch-runbook.md` (241/241) say the same order; line-neutral, rules-only register.
- `check-skill-line-ratchet`, `check-skill-id-lint`, `check-skill-frame-sync`, `check-governed-prose`, `check-half-states --self-test` (no H-row pins the sentence — grep 取卡全序 over `scripts/`), `check-governed-merges --test` exit 3, whole-repo lint — exits captured before any pipe.
- Governed (`.claude/**`): draft PR, seat review at contract tier, `os-zhuang` + `hotlong`, `needs-user-decision` + 维护者速读, human merge.

## Serial plan

`SKILL.md` is held by flight A (PR #16339) and the devx seat's PR #16271; this card folds into the SKILL.md half of the finding-threshold card filed in the same stroke (same file, same register, no conflicting ruling), with a merge-tree proof against both open heads.
